QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Victoria Island Dispatch
QuestInfo.0: Your mission has begun. Listen to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart wants you to go to Victoria Island and investigate the Black Wings. Roca, the Knights' informant dispatched to Henesys, will explain the details.
QuestInfo.2: You met the informant, Roca, at Henesys. You... THINK you can trust him.
